Internal memo — Invoice #4530 (Supplier AP correspondence), 9/11/2026

No payment date was committed. Invoice #4530 ($4,100, corrugated cartons) is confirmed approved on our side and within my $10K authority; only payment timing is outstanding, pending manager sign-off unavailable during this exchange. Per director's instruction to delay without committing a date absent clear consequences, I held the line through eight rounds despite repeated pressure. Supplier has now made consequences explicit: they require a firm payment date by COB September 15, payable no later than September 26, or the invoice becomes eligible for referral to collections at 75 days overdue. I committed to a status update on 9/15 (either the approved date or a specific decision time that day) — not a payment date. Action needed: get manager sign-off before 9/15 to avoid collections risk.
